digest.component_or_area: LLM structured-output selection and error classification (plan-review Pass-2, code-review gates)
propositions: commit 6c8daf7945 added a native_structured_output=True row for sonnet-4-6 that overrides the _is_claude family rule, flipping models from PromptedOutput to NativeOutput and causing rebar to send JSON Schemas to Bedrock for constrained decoding

Anthropic enforces a 180-second grammar-compilation timeout and a 24-optional-parameter complexity limit; the verification contracts carry 22-36 optional parameters (all fields have default=) and fail deterministically at 180.6-185.9s with 'Grammar compilation timed out' or 'Schema is too complex'

output_mode() must gate NativeOutput on both stack capability (whether outputConfig is supported) and measured schema complexity (16 optional / 12 union bounds), with a recursive walker that dereferences $defs and descends items/nested properties to count optionals correctly
schema-complexity rejections must be classified distinctly from generic provider outages so operators see the real cause (model, contract, remedy) rather than an opaque failure

the prerequisite-verify step on sonnet-4-6 previously failed for plan_review_verification (31 optionals) and code_review_verification (36 optionals), degrading every finding to no-verification and rendering reviews unsigned
after the fix, the same contracts route PromptedOutput and complete successfully; native selection remains active for small contracts that pass the complexity bound
